gasDiagnosis.assessment: Saved gas=591905 and maxFeePerGas=200000000000 require up to 0.118381 MON upfront, while the creator holds 0.05099345 MON. Insufficient upfront gas balance is a concrete candidate cause of repeated unmined retries, not a replayed RPC rejection or permission to fund/re-sign.

knownAmounts.note: Balances are shared contract totals, not per-job escrow proofs. Terms and settlement flags establish each named obligation. The original v1 Holding has 1.8 mUSD total; this audit does not allocate the other 0.9 mUSD to a specific job.

limits: Scoped to eight named jobs and the known budget run; not a global no-obligation certificate.
Original demo-v2 owed(token,wallet) getter reverted for every participant; unsupported old ABI or non-exposed mapping means unknown, never zero.
Legacy bonds are FACTORY v1 ERC20 custody, not SIDE/FACTORY v2 StakeVault reservations.
Only job131 creator and worker reservations were read; their zero reservations do not establish zero global vault liabilities.
